claim: The ant toolkit describes code-drawn textured 2D scenes and cross-sections.
quote: paper grain, hatching, brush ink, watercolour that blooms
assessment_reason: Creator description, corroborated by inspected drawing modules and an older saved contact sheet; no new quality test.

claim: The ant package declares @napi-rs/canvas ^0.1.65 as its sole direct dependency.
quote: "dependencies": { "@napi-rs/canvas": "^0.1.65" }
assessment_reason: Complete manifest read. Transitive dependencies and installation compatibility were not tested.

claim: The ant renderer takes width, height, frame rate and duration from the film specification.
quote: const W = F.W, H = F.H, fps = F.fps || 24, N = Math.round(F.dur * fps)
assessment_reason: Full renderer creates the canvas and FFmpeg output using these values. Vertical composition remains work to author and test.

claim: The supplied ant drawing explicitly implements a one-node waist.
quote: // ---------------- petiole: the narrow waist with one node
assessment_reason: Drawing code and surrounding body paths read. This is not verified red-imported-fire-ant anatomy.

claim: The colony module supplies cocoon artwork.
quote: export function cocoon(ctx, s = 1)
assessment_reason: Full module read. Its capsule-shaped cocoon must not stand in for the naked fire-ant pupa described by Texas A&M.

claim: Texas A&M describes fire-ant pupae as naked, without enclosing cocoons.
quote: Pupae of some species, like fire ants, are “naked”
assessment_reason: The paragraph directly contrasts naked fire-ant pupae with other species having capsule-like cocoons.

claim: Texas A&M says fire-ant mounds have no central opening and describes entry through underground tunnels.
quote: The mound has no opening in the center like most ant mounds.
assessment_reason: The next sentence describes the underground entry tunnels. Do not reuse a different-ant demo central mound entrance.

claim: The colony demo fixes 1920x1080, 24 fps and 32 seconds.
assessment_reason: Declaration directly read. Snapshot is truncated; the complete film was not audited. New vertical layout and narration timing are needed.

claim: The ant-animation repository carries an MIT license.
quote: MIT License
assessment_reason: Full license retrieved. Preserve notices when adapting code. Transitive dependency terms were not audited.

claim: Anidoodle documents a folk-tale storybook style with paint and pencil on cream paper.
quote: | **Folk-tale storybook** | Painted foreground dissolving into pencil line on cream paper |
assessment_reason: A candidate visual vocabulary described by its author; not a tested fire-ant result.

claim: Anidoodle lists esbuild, Playwright Core and TypeScript, with Remotion/React packages in optional dependencies.
quote: "optionalDependencies": {
assessment_reason: Complete manifest read: Remotion/React appear in this block; esbuild and Playwright/TypeScript are separate. Install behavior remains untested.

claim: Anidoodle carries the Apache License, Version 2.0.
quote: Version 2.0, January 2004
assessment_reason: Full repository license retrieved. Applicable notice requirements and dependency licenses remain relevant.

claim: Anidoodle documents a repeated-frame problem in its butterfly example opening.
quote: there are 49 identical consecutive frames
assessment_reason: The example README reports a failed dead-air check. This is a reported limitation, not a test performed here.

claim: The butterfly source specifies square 1080x1080 frames and derives duration from imported cues.
quote: meta: { title: "mechanicalLepidoptera", W: 1080, H: 1080, fps: 30, bpm: 120, durationFrames: TOTAL }
assessment_reason: Direct source declaration. Header says 60 seconds, README says 47; imported cue values were not evaluated, leaving actual duration unresolved.

claim: The inspected Remotion license lists for-profit organizations up to three employees as eligible for free use; other groups and company-license conditions apply.
quote: - a for-profit organization with up to 3 employees
assessment_reason: Full license read, including other eligible groups and Company License. Entity eligibility was not assessed. File also flags Remotion 5 changes; do not assume commercial use is free.

claim: Motion Canvas is designed for informative vector animations synchronized with voiceovers.
quote:
informative vector animations and
synchronize them with voice-overs.
assessment_reason: Primary README supports timing relevance, not proof of textured pest illustration quality.

claim: HyperFrames describes turning HTML, CSS, media and seekable animations into MP4.
quote: HyperFrames is an open-source framework for turning HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos.
assessment_reason: Relevant primary README section read; snapshot truncated. General rendering capability, not a ready pest illustration library or measured determinism.

claim: HandDraw describes its core as whiteboard-animation rendering.
quote: Agent-native, deterministic whiteboard-animation rendering.
assessment_reason: Complete short README read, including limited animation vocabulary and separate companion for colorful stories.

claim: Anidoodle publishes a renderer that opens a Playwright adapter and encodes frames with FFmpeg.
quote: const t0 = Date.now(), session = await playwright.open(env, page.out, { scale, workers })
assessment_reason: Full script read, including the FFmpeg spawn. Supports local requirements; no renderer was executed.

claim: The ant demo expects fonts under a Claude-specific folder and a macOS system-font path.
quote: const FD = process.env.FONT_DIR || path.join(process.env.HOME, ".claude/skills/tesseract-edit/assets/fonts");
assessment_reason: Adjacent registrations use Inter files and /System/Library/Fonts/Menlo.ttc. A Linux adaptation should select explicit available fonts.
